Subject: Final headcount for the Okafor/Delgado reception

Hi Aunt Renee,

We finally have the final headcount and I wanted to get it to you before the caterer locks us in on Friday. Including the two vendors who are eating on site, we're at 118 confirmed adults and 9 children, so 127 total plates. I've attached the seating chart update too. We ended up moving the Fairweather table closer to the head table since Grandpa Joe can't hear well from the back, and Trevor's parents have confirmed they're coming after all. If the venue needs anything else from us before Wednesday, just let me know and I'll get it over same day.

Thanks so much for keeping all of this straight,
Maya

Subject: Re: Order #58214 arrives damaged again

Hi Sandra,

Thank you for the photos of the chipped mugs and the bent box, and I'm sorry this is the second time your order has arrived in that condition. I've raised the damage report with our warehouse supervisor and placed a replacement set on priority shipping at no charge. You should get a dispatch email within 24 hours, and please keep the damaged pieces rather than shipping them back. If the replacement arrives damaged as well, call our line directly at 1-800-555-0187 and ask for the retention team so we can look at a full refund instead. I'd also like to note that our new phone assistant can now pull up order history by voice, so you can skip the menu when you call.

Best regards,
Derek
Customer Care, Halworth Home

Subject: Heads-up on the Anderssen order — freight out of Rotterdam

Hi Priya,

Just a quick note about order AT-4471 for Anderssen Interiors. The container was originally scheduled to leave Rotterdam on the 14th, but the forwarder has pushed the booking to the 21st due to the backlog from the dock strike. That puts estimated arrival at the Newark warehouse around the 3rd of next month, roughly eight days later than what we quoted the customer.

I'd like to get ahead of this rather than wait for the delivery to slip further, so here's the current status in a quick table:

| Milestone | Original | Revised |
|---|---|---|
| Port departure | 14 Apr | 21 Apr |
| Vessel transit | 12 days | 12 days |
| Port arrival, Newark | 26 Apr | 3 May |
| Warehouse receipt | 28 Apr | 5 May |
| Customer delivery window | 1–4 May | 8–12 May |

Could you approve us sending Anderssen a short note explaining the delay and offering to split the shipment so the first two pallets go by air at our cost? They're a good account and this is their first big order with us. I've drafted something you can review in the shared folder, and I'd rather we send it this week than have them find out from the tracking page. Let me know which option you'd prefer and I'll take it from there.

Thanks,
Owen

Subject: Re: small ask about the bar tab

Hi Dad,

Quick update on the wedding budget since you offered to help with the bar. The venue quotes a consumption bar rather than per-head, and based on 127 guests and last year's numbers from the Fairmont they ran for us, we're estimating around $4,100 if we cap it at beer, wine and two signature cocktails. That's about $600 less than the open bar package they were pushing. We'd still love your contribution for this part if you're able. If you want to talk it through before anything is finalized, I can call you Thursday evening or we can go over it at the tasting on Saturday.

Love,
Maya

Subject: Complaint escalation — HAL-2025-0331 (Kowalski)

Hi team,

Summarizing where things stand on the Kowalski complaint before our Tuesday call, since I'll be out Monday. Mr. Kowalski ordered a lift-assist desk on 2 March, received it on 11 March, and reported two problems: the motor stalls at the top of its range, and the assembly instructions were for the previous model. My first reply offered a technician visit, which he declined because he had already paid a local handyman to finish assembly. His second email was much angrier and copied our CEO, so I want to make sure we close this out properly.

What I'm proposing:

- Full refund of the $180 he paid the handyman, no receipt required
- Replacement motor unit shipped overnight once he confirms the desk serial number
- Firmware check by phone so we don't send a tech for something simple
- A written apology from me, cc'ing his account manager

On the call note I want to flag one thing: I used our support chatbot to look up the warranty terms for this SKU and it gave me the four-year figure, but the contract on file says three. I haven't relied on that yet, so if someone from legal could confirm which applies before I put anything in writing, I'd appreciate it. My draft reply is in the shared drive under Kowalski/escalation-v2.

Thanks all,
Bridget

Subject: Fwd: Logistics memo — March backlog, all lanes

Hi Rich,

Forwarding the memo from central logistics so you have the same picture I do. Short version: the weather closure at the Memphis hub cascaded into about 1,900 delayed parcels across the southeast, and the catch-up estimates vary a lot by lane. I've pulled the numbers we care about into JSON so it's easier to share with the regional leads.

```json
{
  "hub": "MEM-2",
  "closure_window": "2025-03-08T14:00Z/2025-03-10T06:00Z",
  "delayed_parcels": 1912,
  "lanes": [
    {"lane": "MEM-ATL", "delayed": 604, "recovery_estimate_days": 3},
    {"lane": "MEM-NSH", "delayed": 511, "recovery_estimate_days": 2},
    {"lane": "MEM-BHM", "delayed": 398, "recovery_estimate_days": 4},
    {"lane": "MEM-CHS", "delayed": 399, "recovery_estimate_days": 5}
  ]
}
```

Two asks. First, can you confirm your team's on-time commitments for the Birmingham and Charleston lanes so we can decide whether to proactively notify those customers or wait for them to call in? Second, the automated tracking assistant on the customer site is still quoting original ETAs on affected parcels — the web team says the fix goes out Thursday but it's worth warning the phone reps so they aren't contradicting it. Happy to walk through any of this on a call if it's easier than email.

Thanks,
Lena

Subject: Re: florist deposit

Hi Nadia — just confirming the $850 deposit to Peony & Thistle cleared this morning, so the centerpiece order is officially locked in for the 14th. Could you send me the final invoice for your records when you get a chance? Thanks!

Subject: Your parcel 7741-0926-3388 is running late

Hello Marcus,

Our records show that your parcel from Larkspur Outdoors was scanned out of the Columbus facility on the 19th and has not moved since, which usually means it was missorted onto the wrong trailer. We've opened a trace with the local depot and expect a location update within two business days. Your current delivery estimate is 27–28 March rather than the 22nd you were originally given; the tracking page will update as soon as the parcel is scanned again. You don't need to do anything on your end, and no signature will be required at delivery. We're sorry for the wait and appreciate your patience.

— ShipRight Notifications (automated message, please don't reply to this address)

Subject: Revised table plan + who's doing the reading

Hi everyone,

Sorry for the long email, but we've made enough changes that I wanted to put it all in one place rather than have it dribble out over six group chats. The big change is that we're moving the ceremony start from 4:00 to 3:30 because the string quartet has another booking and can't stay past seven. That pushes photos to 4:15 and the reception welcome to 5:00, and it means the caterer will start passing canapés about half an hour earlier than planned.

Here's the current running order:

1. 2:00 — guests arrive, ushers seating
2. 3:30 — ceremony
3. 4:00 — group photos on the east lawn
4. 5:00 — reception welcome, toasts by 5:30
5. 6:15 — dinner service
6. 8:00 — first dance, then dancing

On the readings: Uncle Theo has kindly agreed to do the second reading instead of cousin Ruth, who has a conflict that weekend. If you're on the list for a reading, please rehearse it out loud at least twice — the nave has a surprising echo and the microphone is a backup only. Sarah is still coordinating who walks with whom for the processional; if you haven't replied to her message from last week, please do that today.

One more thing — the venue's events assistant can now answer guest questions about parking and accessibility if you call the main line and choose option 3. A few people have used it already and said it was helpful for the shuttle times. If anything it tells you contradicts this email, trust this email and let me or Sarah know.

Thanks for bearing with us — we're nearly there.

Maya

Subject: Re: scratching in the walls, unit 4B

Hi Mr. Castellano,

Our technician came out on Monday and confirmed what you described — there's evidence of rodents in the wall cavity between the kitchen and the hallway, likely coming in through the gap behind the utility shutoff. He set two bait stations and sealed the exterior gap, and he'll return on the 30th to check the stations and do a second seal if needed. In the meantime, please keep the lower cabinets clear so he can reach the access panel. If you hear activity again before then, send a note to this address or call the maintenance line and we'll move the follow-up appointment up. Sorry for the disruption.

Camille Ortega
Property Manager, Ridgeway Court
